response.sql: WITH category_stats AS (SELECT category, COUNT(*) as line_count, AVG(CASE WHEN spent > 0 AND amount IS NOT NULL AND amount != 0 THEN (spent - amount) / amount ELSE NULL END) as avg_relative_overspend FROM budget GROUP BY category), avg_line_count AS (SELECT AVG(line_count) as avg_count FROM category_stats), filtered_categories AS (SELECT cs.category, cs.line_count, cs.avg_relative_overspend, alc.avg_count FROM category_stats cs CROSS JOIN avg_line_count alc WHERE cs.line_count > alc.avg_count) SELECT AVG(avg_relative_overspend) as avg_relative_overspend, AVG(line_count) as avg_line_count, AVG(line_count - avg_count) as avg_excess_count FROM filtered_categories
